description: Team from Sarawak. Interested in space & tech. Skills in research & design. Looking for teammates who like teamwork, coding, or creative ideas. Let's join and build together!
summary: we developed an interactive website about earth analogs and future moon and mars bases. the website explains how extreme places on earth, such as deserts,volcanic fields, polar regions and isolated research stations, can simulate the harsh conditions astronauts may face on the moon and mars. Our project present information about habitat design, survival system, water and oxygen recycling, food production, radiation protection and communication challenges. it also compares the moon and mars as possible locations for future human bases. This project is important because it helps students and the public understand how scientists use earth analog missions to test technologies before real space settlement. By learning about these environments, we can better prepare for long term human exploration beyond earth.
